title: fix(plugin-audit)!: serve the ledger’s deployment-level rows to the platform administrator alone, in every posture
body:
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DUkDtugva69s3nUwLDmAzKf)_ Fixes #26750 Clause-②: no (narrowing) Metadata-protocol: none Skills-docs: updated here ## 维护者速读 - **改了什么**：合规审计账本里不属于任何组织的部署级记录(`tenant_id` 为空：全局设置变更、用户导入、平台管理员身份变更、管理员建号与重置密码),在所有租户姿态下(含 `single`)只给平台管理员看;其他读者，包括 `view_all_audit_log` 的持有者，只看属于某个组织的记录。 - **为什么改**：落实 #26750 的裁决 A。`single` 姿态下组织行策略被剥离，任何拿到账本读权的人都能读到部署级记录。 - **风险与回滚**：读范围收窄(BREAKING)。`single` 部署里自建的审计角色和组织管理员将看不到部署配置历史;记录仍在库，系统上下文的导出不受影响。回滚即 revert 本 PR,无数据迁移。 - **先看**:`packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/audit-log-read-visibility.ts`(中间件末尾新增的一行规则与 `readsDeploymentLevelLedgerRows`)、`packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/audit-log-deployment-level-rows.integration.test.ts`、`packages/qa/dogfood/test/admin-ledger-decision-metadata.dogfood.test.ts`(按裁决翻转的钉子)。 - **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-audit exec vitest run src/audit-log-deployment-level-rows.integration.test.ts`,预期 `single` / `group` / `isolated` 三个姿态共 18 条全绿。 - **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。 ## What changes - **The read rule** (`packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/audit-log-read-visibility.ts`). On every non-system engine read of `sys_audit_log` (find, findOne, count, aggregate), a reader that is not the platform administrator gets one more clause ANDed into its `where`: `tenant_id` is neither null nor empty. It is added after the parent-record gate, which plans its parents off the read's own `where`, and it reaches the holder of `view_all_audit_log` too, whom that gate exempts. The platform administrator is the carried `PLATFORM_ADMIN` posture rung (`PLATFORM_OPERATOR_POSTURE`, ADR-0095 D2/D3), which the unscoped `admin_full_access` grant derives. Positions, set names and capabilities are not read, and a context with no rung gets the clause. Writes, system-context reads and context-less programmatic reads are untouched. Which organization's rows an organization reader is served stays the row policy's answer (ADR-0131 D8). The module is not re-exported, so the package's public surface is unchanged. - **The capability text** (`packages/spec/src/security/capabilities.ts`). The `view_all_audit_log` description gains one sentence for `single`. Nothing else in `packages/spec` changes. - **Docs.** One sentence in `content/docs/permissions/record-view-auditing.mdx`. - **Changeset** `.changeset/26750-ledger-deployment-level-rows.md`: patch for both packages, the two declaration lines, a BREAKING banner, and an upgrade note for `single` operators who granted the ledger to someone who is not the platform administrator. ## Why Ruling A on #26750 (comment 6457448424): deployment-level ledger rows (no `tenant_id`, ADR-0131 D7) are served only to the platform administrator in every tenancy posture, `single` included, and an organization-scoped holder of `view_all_audit_log` reads only the rows about its organization(s). Under `single` the shipped row policy `sys_audit_log_org` is stripped (a platform tenant policy by provenance, ADR-0105 D3), so every reader with a ledger grant was served those rows. On the ruling's "its superuser read bypass": the bypass (`viewAllRecords`) skips plugin-security's Layer 1 only and never reaches this plugin's read middleware. So the rule reads the carried rung that names the platform administrator, and no new capability is introduced. ## Tests - `audit-log-read-visibility.test.ts` (unit): - the clause's shape, and a fresh tree per call; - the rung-only predicate: `TENANT_ADMIN`, `MEMBER`, `EXTERNAL`, a mis-cased rung, no rung, `platform_admin` as a position, and `admin_full_access` as a permission or a capability all answer false; - a non-holder gets the gate, then the clause; - a holder on every non-admin rung gets the clause alone, on find, findOne, count and aggregate; - the platform administrator, with or without the capability, gets no clause; - writes, system reads and context-less reads get none. - `audit-log-read-visibility.integration.test.ts`: the fixture rows now carry the tenant each real writer stamps. A new case serves the deployment-level rows to the platform administrator alone; the member, the other member, the organization admin and the holder are served none. - `audit-log-deployment-level-rows.integration.test.ts` (new): one boot per posture (`single`, `group`, `isolated`) with the real CRUD mirror. The organization holder and the organization admin are served their organization's rows and no deployment-level row, through find, count, a `tenant_id: null` filter, findOne by id and a grouped aggregate. The platform administrator is served both. - The dogfood pin sweep. Both files were named to the seat and added to the claim's file surface before they were edited. - `audit-log-audit-capability.dogfood.test.ts`: the broad read's bulk rows were system inserts with no `tenant_id`, which made them deployment-level rows. They now carry the holder's organization, as the CRUD mirror stamps a row about a record of it. The test's subject is unchanged. - `admin-ledger-decision-metadata.dogfood.test.ts`: **a pin flip caused by ruling 6457448424, not a fix-to-green.** Every row about the subject (plugin-auth's explicit rows and the mirror's rows, written by the platform administrator's endpoints with no organization) is deployment-level, so no class reader can be served one in any posture. The decisions-only guarantee is now asserted at the producer, on the rows at rest. The read side pins the ruling: every reader is served only a control row about the same subject that carries the readers' organization, and the platform administrator is served every row. The armed checks keep their shape: the rows exist and the mirror carries every class; every reader opens the subject; no row about the subject carries an organization, and every reader is served the control row. - Two plugin-audit fixtures the full package suite found (inside the claim's surface, "its tests under `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/`"): - `audit-log-field-redaction.test.ts`: the rows from other writers were system inserts with no `tenant_id`, so the organization readers there were no longer served them. They carry the Default Organization, as a tenant-scope writer stamps them. The redaction cases are unchanged. - `parent-record-read-leaf.integration.test.ts`: the rows about no record carry the Default Organization the same way. The observer that records each ledger read's WHERE "as the gates left it" takes the deployment-level clause, ANDed after the gate, off what it records, so the gate's own WHERE is still what is measured. The holder's case now also pins that the clause is there. ## Acceptance notes - **Measurement (the card's first step).** Under `group` and `isolated`, a custom set that grants the ledger read and `view_all_audit_log` and omits `sys_audit_log_org` was measured on a real boot before the change. Its holder was served only its own organization's rows, so that set has no NULL-tenant leak to fix. - **The cross-organization half is outside this card.** The same measurement found that under a wall, a custom set that authors its own ledger row policy, or that grants the read bypass on the ledger, is served rows beyond its holder's organization. This change closes the deployment-level half of that: those rows are now the platform administrator's alone, in every posture. Rows about other organizations stay reachable through such a set. No reproduction detail is given here; the withheld detail stays on #26640. - The ledger rows stay stored, and nothing is re-attributed (the ruling: not B). ## Verification Final head `af925f22`. It differs from `173abc30` only in the two plugin-audit fixtures above, which no dogfood file runs.
Ablation 1: the rule line replaced by a marker, three plugin-audit files: 20 red, restored ```text node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --file packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/audit-log-read-visibility.ts \ --anchor 'if (!readsDeploymentLevelLedgerRows(ctx.context)) andIntoWhere(ctx, ledgerRowAboutAnOrganizationWhere());' \ --replacement '// ABLATION: the deployment-level rule removed' -- pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-audit exec vitest run \ src/audit-log-read-visibility.test.ts src/audit-log-read-visibility.integration.test.ts src/audit-log-deployment-level-rows.integration.test.ts ablation-replace: ok mutation landed: anchor 1 -> 0, blob c49da4b4973d -> f05a69cb34ea Test Files 3 failed (3) Tests 20 failed | 44 passed (64) `git diff HEAD` is empty ```
Ablation 2: the predicate also reads a platform_admin position: the rung-only pin red, restored ```text --anchor 'return context?.posture === PLATFORM_OPERATOR_POSTURE;' --replacement 'return context?.posture === PLATFORM_OPERATOR_POSTURE || ((context as any)?.positions ?? []).includes("platform_admin"); // ABLATION: positions read beside the rung' Test Files 1 failed | 2 passed (3) Tests 1 failed | 63 passed (64) × the platform administrator is the carried PLATFORM_ADMIN rung, and nothing else AssertionError: {"userId":"u1","positions":["platform_admin"]}: expected true to be false ablation-replace: ok restored: blob == HEAD (c49da4b4973d) and `git diff HEAD` is empty ```
